name: @mooter/vllm-backend
description: Mooter vLLM backend (Wave 32) — OPT-IN high-throughput local serving (16.6× concurrent vs Ollama) + Multi-LoRA (6 adapters concurrent, hot-swap). Detects CUDA/prereqs and refuses gracefully when absent; default backend stays Ollama. Multi-LoRA selection delegates to the Wave 31 LORAUTER. Pure TS, all I/O injectable.
